entities.summary: Drake Batherson is an American-born Canadian professional ice hockey player who is a right winger for the Ottawa Senators of the National Hockey League (NHL). He was drafted by the Ottawa Senators in the fourth round, 121st overall, of the 2017 NHL entry draft.
